quality.basis: 崩溃差分（PoV 可压缩提交，判定端展开后运行 harness）；需要约 14 GB 内存，本机未实测

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the exploit's payload (`http://a?` and NUL bytes to 4294967396 bytes; bzip2 -9: conversion/c5/gt/h2o/vulnerability_WF_LLM_3/payload.bin.bz2, 3,050 bytes) needs about 14 GB of memory to run, so the bundle does not carry it: build.sh's self-check would exhaust an ordinary machine

review.note: the payload is a 4 GB file (a length wrap-around), too large to bundle or submit; it does crash the vulnerable build only

category5.design: Only segment lengths of at least 2^32 are truncated, so any PoC must expand to more than 4 GiB; the judge expands a compressed PoC and runs the harness with the exploit's -rss_limit_mb=0 (cwd /out, which the run user cannot write, so no 4 GiB crash artifact is written). Unusable in a standard task server: libFuzzer holds the input and its copy, the fixed build also allocates and copies 4 GiB (about 14 GB of memory).
